stem: A pesticide-treated area has an application record, but the current reentry information cannot be confirmed. What should the worker do?
choices: Do not enter until the applicable label and access/reentry requirements are verified
Enter briefly if no odor is present
Enter if another worker says enough time has passed
Wear any available gloves and proceed
rationale: Access decisions should be based on verified label and applicable worker-protection requirements, not odor, memory, or informal reassurance.
